resources.string: String extra: packageName\nUse the full package name, for example com.spotify.music.

String extras: settingName and settingValue

Supported settingName values:
%1$s

Use true or false for settingValue. For dozeEnterDelay, use an integer from 0 to 1800 seconds.

These actions update your preferences. Device control still requires working Shizuku or root access and the permissions shown in Settings.

Legacy aliases remain accepted: enableSensors is the inverse of disableMotionSensors; ignoreIfHotspot is the inverse of respectHotspot; useAutoRotateAndBrightnessFix maps to autoRotateAndBrightnessFix.
